scope: Original non-PIE standard FIX executable, 8 MPI ranks per case, first four 20-second steps. B1 and DM065; no executable modifications, physics changes, candidate policy changes, or recompilation.

debugger.launch: Rank wrapper starts GDB as direct parent of each selected WRF process; other ranks execute the identical standard binary. GDB disables debuginfod and leaves ASLR enabled. Script, wrapper, environment, CPU sets and all input/source identities must be frozen and reviewed before any launch.

phase_0_all_rank_parity.capture: At original KDM6 entry and return, use read-only memory access to capture the first-call global 14 wrapper fields and all selected 123-cell x 39-level 16-field entry/return values for steps 1–4. Include rank, function call, timestep and global bounds. Reconstruct TK as actual float32 TH*PII, explicitly distinguishing this from observed memory if it is not stored at the entry. Require byte parity with prior CP04 corresponding values, and whole h00 history byte parity, before interpreting producer events.
phase_0_all_rank_parity.volume: At least 2 x 2,533,440 x 14 x 4 bytes for first-entry global fields plus selected snapshots and metadata; record actual counts, no missing values interpreted as zero.

abi.architecture: x86-64 SysV: entry args 1..6 in RDI, RSI, RDX, RCX, R8, R9; argument n>=7 is the pointer at entry RSP+8*(n-6). Fortran explicit-shape real arrays use column-major offset ((j-jms)*nk+(k-kms))*ni+(i-ims), times four bytes; bounds and pointer identity must be checked at runtime.

event_contract.call_entry_and_return: Save raw IEEE-754 words for relevant arguments and outputs, pointer addresses and all bounds. Save QNR old/current, advect_tend, sc_tend, msfty, c1/c2, mu old/new/base and dt around rk_update_scalar; save calc_p_rho actual producer inputs ph(k,k+1), alt, t2, t_save, c2a, mu/mut, c1h/c2h, rdnw, t0, smdiv and outputs p/al/pm1. Before calc_p_rho step=0 do not read p/al or pm1 as initialized outputs. Save moist_prep inputs t_new,qv,p,pb,p0,al,alb and output TH/P/PII/rho only after return.
event_contract.watch_after: Hardware write-watch exact four-byte target during the bounded actual operation; record previous/current words, reported stop PC, function/return address, argument identities and raw integer/vector registers. A watchpoint stop normally reports the PC after a store, so its reported PC alone is not asserted to identify the producer instruction.
event_contract.writer_replay: On a second deterministic matching replay, break before the independently decoded candidate store; record actual pre-store registers/vector lanes, effective address, relevant memory operands, raw pre/post words and instruction bytes. Verify exact address and IEEE-754 reproduction or state an unresolved rounding/ISA limitation; do not infer causal transport from an unseparated tendency.
event_contract.initial_input_gap: Map QNR slice from rk_update_scalar to KDM by base pointer and verified bounds. If divergence exists before the first QNR update, use a second replay to bind the scalar slice relative to the solve_em input pointer and trace earlier writes; do not assert the first observed RK update caused a preexisting difference.

gates: Inputs and executable hashes pinned before and after each job; h00 history byte-identical to corresponding six-hour reference.
All-rank first-call 14-field and first-four-call 123-cell 16-field parity against previous CP04 captures, including owner/call/bounds coverage, before interpreting any writer.

Each watched address is checked against the expected selected cell and the original KDM argument pointer; target source operations, PC instruction bytes and actual vector lane must be verified on replay.
Potential timing or MPI failures remain failed attempts; no normalization, selective dropping, missing-as-zero, or source-only causal attribution.
Save commands, GDB script and version, affinity, process exits, raw capture, source and binary hashes, and explicit unresolved limits on Lustre; preserve every attempt.
